name: semver-compare
description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 comparison and range matching. "compare" mode ranks two version strings (-1/0/1) with correct prerelease precedence (rejecting invalid versions such as a leading-zero numeric prerelease identifier, e.g. "1.0.0-01"). "satisfies" mode checks a version against an npm-style range expression supporting ^, ~, >=, <=, >, <, =, x/*/X wildcards, || alternatives, hyphen ranges ("1.2.3 - 2.0.0"), and optional whitespace after an operator (">= 1.2.0"). Use this instead of naive string or numeric comparison of version numbers, which gets prerelease ordering and range logic wrong.

mode.description: "compare" ranks two versions; "satisfies" checks a version against a range.

version.description: Version to test. Required for mode "satisfies".

range.description: Range expression, e.g. "^1.2.3", ">= 1.0.0 <2.0.0 || 3.x" (whitespace after an operator is fine), or a hyphen range "1.2.3 - 2.0.0". Required for mode "satisfies".

result.description: compare: -1 if a<b, 0 if equal precedence, 1 if a>b.
